sources.title: Bradley 4 Rack Digital Food Smoker BTDS76CE - Van Hattem Horeca
Bradley Digital 4 Rack Smoker - Tucker BBQ

btds76ce.summary: A bench-top electric food smoker with four removable racks, digital control of temperature, time and smoke, and an automatic bisquette feed that lets it run for several hours unattended. Suited to small kitchens, delis and pubs wanting to smoke meat, fish, cheese and vegetables without a full-size smokehouse.

highlights.text: Digital timer and temperature display; modular automatic smoke generator with timer allows up to 8 hours of smoking.
Digital controls for temperature, time and smoke; cooking element controllable up to 160 C.

facts.label: Minimum temperature
facts.value: approx. 35-40 C, subject to ambient conditions

facts.label: Racks
facts.value: 4 adjustable racks, 279 mm x 330 mm cooking space each

facts.label: Exterior dimensions
facts.value: 430 mm W x 360 mm D x 700 mm H

facts.label: Interior dimensions
facts.value: 400 mm W x 300 mm D x 600 mm H

facts.label: Power model
facts.value: 240 Volt model, 2 amps (Australian variant; SKU also written BTDS76CEEU)

btds76ce.notes: Retailers disagree on size: NL page 80x43x37 cm (interior 648x381x292 mm), AU page 700 H x 430 W x 360 D (interior 600x400x300 mm); Caterkwik states 465x360x790 and 108 L, neither seen. The AU page is a 240 V Australian variant, treat as secondary. Included items are from the AU page only. Check against Bradley/UK distributor datasheet.

sources.title: Hobart Minijet 6 level GN 1/1 electric oven spec sheet (ref. B2MJ061E)
Hobart Bonnet Minijet 6 Grid 1/1 GN Combi Oven (Advantage Catering)

b1mj061e.summary: The Hobart Bonnet Minijet is a compact six-level GN 1/1 electric combi oven only 525 mm wide, with a touchscreen control and automatic cleaning. It runs from a single-phase 230V or three-phase 400V supply at 6.3 kW. Suits small restaurants, cafes and bars wanting combi cooking on a worktop or stand.

highlights.text: CoreControl adjusts power to the actual product load
Six cooking modes including low and high temperature steam and regeneration
Automatic FullCleaning System with integral chemical pump (3 levels)
Cavity runners supplied as a 12 level set at 22 mm spacing
Stackable with kit; compatible with Advancia worktop installation

facts.label: Cavity dimensions (H x W x D)
Installation type
facts.value: Against a wall; stackable with its kit

facts.label: Automatic cleaning
facts.value: FullCleaning System with integral chemical pump, 3 levels (19 min / 30 L water / 0.18 L product; 25 min / 31 L / 0.3 L; 35 min / 38 L / 0.39 L)

facts.label: Door
facts.value: Cool-touch double glazed clip-in door, hinged left, push closure, opens to 180°

facts.label: Cooking modes
facts.value: Convection 0-250 °C; saturated steam to 98 °C; combined 30-250 °C (humidity 0-99%); low temperature steam 30-97 °C; high temperature steam 99-105 °C; regeneration

facts.label: Controls
facts.value: VisioPAD toughened glass touch panel with colour LCD and coding knob

facts.label: Connectivity
facts.value: USB port (accessory) for recipe exchange and backup

facts.label: Probe
facts.value: Core probe socket; removable core probe is an accessory

facts.label: Standards
facts.value: EN 60-335-2-42 (safety of electrical appliances); XP U 60-010 (hygiene)

facts.label: Cold water max temperature
facts.value: 23 °C; 168 µm filter integral with the oven

facts.label: Water quality
facts.value: Hardness TH 4 to 7 °e (60 to 100 ppm); chloride max 150 mg/l; chlorine max 0.2 mg/l; pH 6.5 to 9; conductivity 50 µS/cm

included: Runners with 12 levels spaced 22 mm apart
Core probe socket (probe itself is an accessory)

images.alt: Hobart Bonnet Minijet 6 grid combi oven

b1mj061e.notes: Sheet on this page is for B2MJ061E, not B1MJ061E: confirm they are the same model. Caterkwik D695 x H1030 does not match the sheet (D912 x H746). Caterkwik gasKw 0.3, amps 1 A, gas BSP connections and 'three phase' are wrong or unsupported for this electric oven. Retailer says 2 years warranty; Caterkwik 1 year.

beje101.summary: The Hobart Bonnet Equajet BEJE101 is a floor-standing ten-level GN 1/1 electric combi oven with a touchscreen panel and injection steam. It is hard-wired to a three-phase supply at 15.3 kW. Suits restaurants, hotels and canteens producing mid-sized batches.

highlights.text: Ten GN 1/1 levels at 67 mm spacing
Six cooking modes from convection to high-temperature steam and regeneration
CoreControl adjusts power to the load; Airdry+ for crisp finishes
Left-hinged double-glazed door opens to 180 degrees
Semi-automatic cleaning programme; automatic FullCleaning System available as an option
